name: Beijing Creative Distribution Automation Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Creative Distribution Automation Co., Ltd., together with its affiliated companies, specializes in the design, manufacturing, and commercialization of electrical power distribution equipment across China. Their comprehensive product line includes FLS-Sub transmitters, fault indicators, and advanced fault localization systems for power grids, in addition to pole-mounted automatic circuit reclosers, indoor switchgear units, various cable and cold shrink accessories, and oil-immersed distribution transformers. The enterprise was established in 1988 and operates from its main office in Beijing, China.
